Printed edition: Paul Hentzner's travels in England, during the reign of Queen Elizabeth, translated by Horace, late Earl of Orford, and first printed by him at Strawberry Hill: to which is now added, Sir Robert Naunton's Fragmenta regalia; ... with portraits and views.  1797, 1797, the Internet Archive scan https://archive.org/details/bim_eighteenth-century_paul-hentzners-travels-_hentzner-paul_1797.
